name: hera-app
description: Hera App web + Android wrapper via Capacitor

scripts.android:add: npx cap add android && node scripts/prepare-android.js
scripts.android:sync: npx cap sync android && node scripts/prepare-android.js
scripts.android:apk: sh -c '[ -f android/gradlew ] || { rm -rf android && npx cap add android; }; npx cap sync android; node scripts/prepare-android.js; cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug'
scripts.android:aab: sh -c '[ -f android/gradlew ] || { rm -rf android && npx cap add android; }; npx cap sync android; node scripts/prepare-android.js; cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease'
